articles.title_en: Buying winners
articles.title_cn: 购买赢家
articles.abstract_en: Two principals with heterogenous budgets compete to buy the best agent (the winner). First, the principals make initial offers to the agents before the winner is known. Then, if the winner has not accepted any offer, the principals make a second round of offers after the winner is revealed. In equilibrium, the principal with the higher budget offers her entire budget to the winner after he is revealed. The principal with the lower budget makes an offer to one agent before the winner is revealed. The timing of offers favors the high-budget principal: the low-budget principal faces adverse selection because only an agent with a low win probability accepts her offer. Moreover, the probability that the high-budget principal buys the winner increases with the number of agents. Finally, limiting pre-revelation offers favors the high-budget principal, while the opposite is true for post-revelation limits.
articles.abstract_cn: 两个预算异质的委托人竞争购买最佳代理人（赢家）。首先，在赢家未知之前，委托人向代理人提出初始报价。然后，如果赢家未接受任何报价，在赢家揭晓后，委托人进行第二轮报价。在均衡中，预算较高的委托人在赢家揭晓后向其提供全部预算。预算较低的委托人在赢家揭晓前向一个代理人提出报价。报价的时机有利于高预算委托人：低预算委托人面临逆向选择，因为只有获胜概率低的代理人才会接受其报价。此外，高预算委托人购买赢家的概率随代理人数量增加而增加。最后，限制揭晓前报价有利于高预算委托人，而限制揭晓后报价则相反。

articles.title_en: Obvious manipulations of tops-only voting rules
articles.title_cn: 顶偏好投票规则的明显操纵
articles.abstract_en: In a voting problem with a finite set of alternatives to choose from, we study the manipulation of tops-only rules. Since all non-dictatorial (onto) voting rules are manipulable when there are more than two alternatives and all preferences are allowed, we look for rules in which manipulations are not obvious. First, we show that a rule does not have obvious manipulations if and only if when an agent vetoes an alternative it can do so with any preference that does not have such alternative in the top.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一个从有限备选方案集合中进行选择的投票问题中，我们研究了顶偏好规则的操纵。由于当备选方案多于两个且允许所有偏好时，所有非独裁（满射）投票规则都是可操纵的，我们寻找操纵不明显的规则。首先，我们证明一个规则没有明显操纵当且仅当当一个代理人否决一个备选方案时，它可以以任何不将该备选方案置于顶部的偏好来这样做。

articles.title_en: Rejection-proof mechanisms for multi-agent kidney exchange
articles.title_cn: 多代理肾脏交换的防拒绝机制
articles.abstract_en: Kidney exchange programs (KEPs) increase kidney transplantation by facilitating the exchange of incompatible donors. Increasing the scale of KEPs leads to more opportunities for transplants. Collaboration between transplant organizations (agents) is thus desirable. As agents are primarily interested in providing transplants for their own patients, collaboration requires balancing individual and common objectives. In this paper, we consider ex-post strategic behavior, where agents can modify a proposed set of kidney exchanges. We introduce the class of rejection-proof mechanisms, which propose a set of exchanges such that agents have no incentive to reject them. We provide an exact mechanism and establish that the underlying optimization problem is Σ2P-hard; we also describe computationally less demanding heuristic mechanisms. We show rejection-proofness can be achieved at a limited cost for typical instances. Furthermore, our experiments show that the proposed rejection-proof mechanisms also remove incentives for strategic behavior in the ex-ante setting, where agents withhold information.
articles.abstract_cn: 肾脏交换项目（KEPs）通过促进不兼容捐赠者的交换来增加肾脏移植。扩大KEPs的规模会带来更多的移植机会。因此，移植组织（代理）之间的合作是可取的。由于代理主要关心为自己的患者提供移植，合作需要平衡个体和共同目标。在本文中，我们考虑事后策略行为，即代理可以修改提议的肾脏交换集合。我们引入了防拒绝机制类别，该机制提议一组交换，使得代理没有动机拒绝它们。我们提供了一种精确机制，并确定其底层优化问题是Σ2P-hard的；我们还描述了计算上要求较低的启发式机制。我们表明，对于典型实例，防拒绝性可以以有限的成本实现。此外，我们的实验表明，所提出的防拒绝机制也消除了事前设置中代理隐瞒信息的策略行为动机。

articles.title_en: Communication, renegotiation and coordination with private values
articles.title_cn: 私人价值下的沟通、重新谈判与协调
articles.abstract_en: An equilibrium is communication-proof if it is unaffected by new opportunities to communicate and renegotiate. We characterize the set of equilibria of coordination games with pre-play communication in which players have private preferences over the coordinated outcomes. The set of communication-proof equilibria is a small and relatively homogeneous subset of the set of qualitatively diverse Bayesian Nash equilibria. Under a communication-proof equilibrium, players never miscoordinate, play their jointly preferred outcome whenever there is one, and communicate only the ordinal part of their preferences. Moreover, such equilibria are robust to changes in players' beliefs and interim Pareto efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 如果一个均衡不受新的沟通和重新谈判机会的影响，则该均衡是沟通证明的。我们刻画了具有事前沟通的协调博弈中均衡的集合，其中参与者对协调结果具有私人偏好。沟通证明均衡的集合是定性多样的贝叶斯纳什均衡集合中的一个较小且相对同质的子集。在沟通证明均衡下，参与者永远不会不协调，只要存在共同偏好的结果就会选择该结果，并且只沟通其偏好的序数部分。此外，这样的均衡对参与者信念的变化具有稳健性，并且是中间帕累托有效的。

articles.title_en: Designing rotation programs: Limits and possibilities
articles.title_cn: 设计轮岗计划：限制与可能性
articles.abstract_en: Rotation programs are widely used in our society. For instance, a job rotation program is an HR strategy where employees rotate between two or more jobs in the same business. We study rotation programs within the standard implementation framework under complete information. We introduce the notion of implementation in ordered cycles, where each ordered cycle is a rotation program for an assignment problem. When the designer would like to attain a Pareto efficient goal, we provide sufficient conditions for its implementation in ordered cycles. However, when, for instance, every employee transitions through all different lateral jobs before rotating back to his original one, the conditions fully characterize the class of Pareto efficient goals that are implementable in ordered cycles.
articles.abstract_cn: 轮岗计划在我们的社会中广泛使用。例如，工作轮岗计划是一种人力资源策略，员工在同一企业中轮换两个或更多的工作岗位。我们在完全信息下的标准实施框架内研究轮岗计划。我们引入了有序循环实施的概念，其中每个有序循环是分配问题的轮岗计划。当设计者希望实现帕累托效率目标时，我们为其在有序循环中的实施提供了充分条件。然而，例如，当每个员工在轮回到其原始岗位之前经历所有不同的横向工作岗位时，这些条件完全刻画了可在有序循环中实施的帕累托效率目标类别。

articles.title_en: School choice with transferable student characteristics
articles.title_cn: 具有可转移学生特征的学校选择
articles.abstract_en: We consider school choice problems where school priorities depend on transferable student characteristics. Fair Pareto improvements can alleviate the trade-off between efficiency and stability in this framework. A group of students may improve their outcomes by exchanging their seats and transferable characteristics at the schools they are initially assigned without generating justified envy among the remaining students.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑学校优先权取决于可转移学生特征的学校选择问题。在此框架下，公平的帕累托改进可以缓解效率与稳定性之间的权衡。一组学生可以通过交换他们在最初分配到的学校的座位和可转移特征来改善其结果，而不会在其余学生中产生合理的嫉妒。

articles.title_en: Social roles and competitiveness: My willingness to compete depends on who I am (supposed to be)
articles.title_cn: 社会角色与竞争意愿：我的竞争意愿取决于我是谁（或应该成为谁）
articles.abstract_en: Women frequently react less favorably to competition than men. In this paper, we investigate the effects of social roles on willingness to compete (WTC). Subjects compete in two-person teams. In the treatment, one team member is randomly assigned the role of “breadwinner/manager”, and the other person is randomly assigned as the “supporter/assistant”. The only difference between the roles is the labels. In the baseline, subjects compete without any role assignment. We find women's WTC increases by 41% (44%) when they are assigned as breadwinners (managers) compared to women in the baseline. Men have lower WTC when they are assigned as supporters or assistants. There is no gender gap in WTC in treatment groups. Social norms of competitiveness for each role are elicited, and are suggested as the main driver of changes in WTC by the role assignment. We also examine other potential mechanisms through which social roles affect WTC.
articles.abstract_cn: 女性对竞争的反应往往不如男性积极。在本文中，我们研究了社会角色对竞争意愿（WTC）的影响。受试者在两人团队中竞争。在实验处理中，一名团队成员被随机分配为“养家者/管理者”角色，另一人被随机分配为“支持者/助理”角色。角色之间的唯一区别是标签。在基线条件下，受试者在没有角色分配的情况下竞争。我们发现，与基线条件下的女性相比，被分配为养家者（管理者）的女性的WTC增加了41%（44%）。当男性被分配为支持者或助理时，他们的WTC较低。在处理组中，WTC不存在性别差距。我们引出了每个角色的竞争性社会规范，并认为这些规范是角色分配导致WTC变化的主要驱动因素。我们还考察了社会角色影响WTC的其他潜在机制。

articles.title_en: Order independence for rationalizability
articles.title_cn: 理性化的顺序无关性
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a sufficient monotonicity condition for the solution of a rationalizability procedure to be independent of the order of elimination. The analysis unfolds in an abstract environment that applies to any game and elimination procedure. Monotonicity is satisfied by rationalizability procedures based on monotone belief operators, such as “directed” rationalizability, interim correlated rationalizability, or, in sequential games, initial and backwards rationalizability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为理性化程序的解独立于消除顺序提供了一个充分的单调性条件。分析在一个适用于任何博弈和消除程序的抽象环境中展开。基于单调信念算子的理性化程序满足单调性，例如“定向”理性化、中期相关理性化，或在序贯博弈中的初始和逆向理性化。

articles.title_en: Auction timing and market thickness
articles.title_cn: 拍卖时机与市场厚度
articles.abstract_en: A seller faces a pool of potential bidders that changes over time. She can delay the auction to have a thicker market later on. The seller imposes static distortions (through her choice of reserve prices) and dynamic distortions (through her choice of market thickness). Under a condition on types that generalizes increasing hazard rates, we show that (i) regulating only static distortions can harm efficiency; (ii) when regulating only dynamic distortions, a social planner should reduce market thickness; (iii) if a planner can affect both types of distortions, she should still choose a lower market thickness than the seller, i.e., market thickness is inefficiently high; (iv) the extent of timing disagreement between the seller and a social planner is higher when they both have to use an efficient auction than when they both have to use an optimal one.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个卖方面对一个随时间变化的潜在竞标者池。她可以延迟拍卖以在稍后拥有更厚的市场。卖方施加静态扭曲（通过其保留价的选择）和动态扭曲（通过其市场厚度的选择）。在一种泛化递增风险率的类型条件下，我们表明：（i）仅规制静态扭曲可能损害效率；（ii）当仅规制动态扭曲时，社会计划者应减少市场厚度；（iii）如果计划者能影响两种扭曲，她仍应选择比卖方更低的市场厚度，即市场厚度低效地高；（iv）当双方都必须使用有效拍卖时，卖方与社会计划者之间的时机分歧程度高于双方都必须使用最优拍卖时的情况。

articles.title_en: Commitment requests do not affect truth-telling in laboratory and online experiments
articles.title_cn: 承诺请求不影响实验室和在线实验中的诚实行为
articles.abstract_en: Using a standard cheating game, we investigate whether the request to sign a no-cheating declaration affects truth-telling. Our design varies the content of a no-cheating declaration (reference to ethical behavior vs. reference to possible sanctions) and the type of experiment (online vs. offline). Irrespective of the declaration's content, commitment requests do not affect truth-telling, neither in the laboratory nor online. The inefficacy of commitment requests appears robust across different samples and does not depend on psychological measures of reactance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用标准的作弊游戏，研究签署不作弊声明的要求是否影响诚实行为。我们的设计变化了不作弊声明的内容（提及道德行为与提及可能的制裁）和实验类型（在线与离线）。无论声明的内容如何，承诺请求都不影响诚实行为，无论是在实验室还是在线。承诺请求的无效性在不同样本中表现稳健，并且不依赖于心理测量中的逆反心理。

articles.title_en: The groupwise-pivotal referral auction: Core-selecting referral strategy-proof mechanism
articles.title_cn: 分组关键推荐拍卖：核心选择推荐策略证明机制
articles.abstract_en: We introduce the groupwise-pivotal referral (GPR) mechanism for auctions where buyers can participate through referrals. Each buyer's type consists of a valuation and referable buyers. Unlike the second-price auction (SPA), the Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) mechanism provides referral incentives. However, VCG is not budget-feasible. In contrast, under complete information, GPR is core-selecting, implying efficiency and budget feasibility. Under incomplete information, bidders refer truthfully and have no incentive to underbid in GPR. Furthermore, GPR's ex-post revenue outperforms both VCG and SPA, not just in equilibrium but also when bidders do not use weakly dominated strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了分组关键推荐（GPR）机制，用于买家可以通过推荐参与的拍卖。每个买家的类型包括一个估值和可推荐的买家。与第二价格拍卖（SPA）不同，维克里-克拉克-格罗夫斯（VCG）机制提供了推荐激励。然而，VCG不满足预算可行性。相比之下，在完全信息下，GPR是核心选择的，这意味着效率和预算可行性。在不完全信息下，投标人如实推荐，并且在GPR中没有低报的激励。此外，GPR的事后收入优于VCG和SPA，不仅在均衡中，而且在投标人不使用弱占优策略时也是如此。

articles.title_en: Optimal disclosure in all-pay auctions with interdependent valuations
articles.title_cn: 相互依存估值下全支付拍卖中的最优信息披露
articles.abstract_en: We study all-pay auctions with one-sided private information and interdependent valuations. To sharpen the competition and maximize revenue, the auction organizer can design an information disclosure policy through Bayesian persuasion about the bidder with private information. We characterize optimal disclosure and find that optimal disclosure exhibits almost full disclosure, where the uninformed bidder can always narrow the informed bidder's private information down to at most two types. We also illustrate our characterization in a simple binary-type setting and investigate issues such as comparative statics, welfare, and efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有单边私人信息和相互依存估值的全支付拍卖。为了加剧竞争并最大化收入，拍卖组织者可以通过贝叶斯说服设计关于拥有私人信息的投标人的信息披露政策。我们刻画了最优披露，并发现最优披露表现出几乎完全披露，即不知情的投标人总能将知情投标人的私人信息缩小到至多两种类型。我们还在一个简单的二元类型设置中说明了我们的刻画，并研究了比较静态、福利和效率等问题。

articles.title_en: Believe it or not: Experimental evidence on sunspot equilibria with social networks
articles.title_cn: 信不信由你：关于社会网络中太阳黑子均衡的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: Models with sunspot equilibria have long been a topic of interest among economists. It then became an interesting question to ask whether there is empirical support for their existence. One approach to answer this question is through lab experiments. A growing literature has not only successfully reproduced these equilibria in the lab, but also improved our understanding of the conditions under which they might emerge. We study the importance of information provision, and how it affects convergence dynamics. We run a laboratory experiment in which individuals, connected through a network, directly observe the actions of their neighbors as well as aggregate information. By manipulating both the type of information available and the structure of the network, we show that general information about other players' behavior hinders coordination, while information specifically related to the sunspot enhances it.
articles.abstract_cn: 具有太阳黑子均衡的模型长期以来一直是经济学家感兴趣的话题。随后，一个有趣的问题出现了：是否存在支持这些均衡的经验证据。回答这个问题的一种方法是通过实验室实验。越来越多的文献不仅在实验室中成功重现了这些均衡，而且加深了我们对这些均衡可能出现条件的理解。我们研究信息提供的重要性，以及它如何影响收敛动态。我们进行了一项实验室实验，其中通过网络连接的个体直接观察其邻居的行为以及总体信息。通过操纵可用信息的类型和网络的结构，我们表明，关于其他玩家行为的一般信息会阻碍协调，而与太阳黑子具体相关的信息则会增强协调。

articles.title_en: School choice with costly information acquisition
articles.title_cn: 信息获取成本高昂的择校问题
articles.abstract_en: I study a model of centralized school choice in which students engage in costly search over schools before submitting preference reports to a clearinghouse. I consider three classes of preferences over schools—idiosyncratic, common, and hybrid—and characterize outcomes under two search protocols—simultaneous and sequential. With idiosyncratic preferences, there are no search externalities, and inefficiencies arise only because of uncoordinated search. Common preferences, however, generate search externalities: when high-priority students search, seats available to lower-priority students are adversely selected. Consequently, sequential search generates greater welfare than simultaneous search with idiosyncratic preferences but not necessarily with common. Additionally, with common preferences, welfare is nonmonotonic in search costs. I also show that the search protocol affects outcome inequality in important ways. For both protocols, I provide an instrument by which a designer can break students' indifferences in search strategies to coordinate search and increase welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了一个集中式择校模型，在该模型中，学生在向清算所提交偏好报告之前，会进行成本高昂的学校搜索。我考虑了三种学校偏好类型——特质性、共同性和混合性——并刻画了两种搜索协议（同时搜索和顺序搜索）下的结果。在特质性偏好下，不存在搜索外部性，效率低下仅源于不协调的搜索。然而，共同性偏好会产生搜索外部性：当高优先级学生搜索时，可供低优先级学生选择的席位会出现逆向选择。因此，在特质性偏好下，顺序搜索比同时搜索带来更高的福利，但在共同性偏好下则不一定。此外，在共同性偏好下，福利随搜索成本呈非单调变化。我还表明，搜索协议以重要方式影响结果不平等。对于两种协议，我提供了一种工具，设计者可以通过该工具打破学生在搜索策略中的无差异，以协调搜索并提高福利。

articles.title_en: Singles monotonicity and stability in one-to-one matching problems
articles.title_cn: 一对一匹配问题中的单边单调性与稳定性
articles.abstract_en: We propose a new axiom called “own-side singles monotonicity” in one-to-one matching problems between men and women. Suppose that there is an agent who is not matched in a problem. Suppose for simplicity it is a woman. Now in a new problem, we improve (or leave unchanged) her ranking for each man. Own-side singles monotonicity requires that each woman should not be made better off (except for her). If we focus on improving the ranking of an unmatched woman, then the men-optimal stable solution satisfies this property. By contrast, (if the gender of an unmatched agent is not specified), no single-valued solution satisfies own-side singles monotonicity and stability. However, there is a multi-valued solution, the stable solution, that does. We show that the stable solution is the unique solution satisfying weak unanimity, null agent invariance, own-side singles monotonicity, and consistency, where consistency can be replaced by Maskin invariance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在男性和女性之间的一对一匹配问题中提出了一个新的公理，称为“同侧单身单调性”。假设在一个问题中存在一个未匹配的代理人。为简单起见，假设她是一位女性。现在在一个新问题中，我们提高（或保持不变）她在每个男性那里的排名。同侧单身单调性要求每个女性不应变得更好（除了她本人）。如果我们专注于提高未匹配女性的排名，那么男性最优稳定解满足这一性质。相反，（如果未匹配代理人的性别未指定），则没有任何单值解满足同侧单身单调性和稳定性。然而，存在一个多值解，即稳定解，满足这些性质。我们证明稳定解是唯一满足弱一致性、空代理人不变性、同侧单身单调性和一致性的解，其中一致性可以被马斯金不变性所替代。

articles.title_en: Reallocation with priorities
articles.title_cn: 带优先级的再配置
articles.abstract_en: We consider a reallocation problem with priorities where each agent is initially endowed with a house and is willing to exchange it but each house has a priority ordering over the agents of the market. In this setting, it is well known that there is no individually rational and stable mechanism. As a result, the literature has introduced a modified stability notion called μ0-stability. In contrast to college admission problems, in which priorities are present but there is no initial endowment, we show that the ownership-adjusted Deferred Acceptance mechanism identified in the literature is not the only individually rational, strategy-proof and μ0-stable mechanism. By introducing a new axiom called the independence of irrelevant agents and using the standard axiom of unanimity, we show that the ownership-adjusted Deferred Acceptance mechanism is the unique mechanism that is individually rational, strategy-proof, μ0-stable, unanimous and independent of irrelevant agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个带优先级的再配置问题，其中每个代理人最初拥有一所房子并愿意交换，但每所房子对市场中的代理人有一个优先级排序。在这种设定下，众所周知不存在既个体理性又稳定的机制。因此，文献引入了一种修正的稳定性概念，称为μ0-稳定性。与大学录取问题（其中存在优先级但没有初始禀赋）相比，我们表明文献中确定的产权调整递延接受机制并不是唯一既个体理性、策略-proof又μ0-稳定的机制。通过引入一个称为无关代理人独立性的新公理，并使用标准的 unanimity 公理，我们证明产权调整递延接受机制是唯一既个体理性、策略-proof、μ0-稳定、一致同意且独立于无关代理人的机制。

articles.title_en: The n-player Hirshleifer contest
articles.title_cn: n人赫什莱弗竞赛
articles.abstract_en: While the game-theoretic analysis of conflict is often based on the assumption of multiplicative noise, additive noise such as considered by Hirshleifer (1989) may be equally plausible depending on the application. In this paper, we examine the equilibrium set of the n-player difference-form contest with heterogeneous valuations. For high and intermediate levels of noise, the equilibrium is in pure strategies, with at most one player being active. For small levels of noise, however, we find a variety of equilibria in which some but not necessarily all players randomize. In the case of homogeneous valuations, we obtain a partial uniqueness result for symmetric equilibria. As the contest becomes increasingly decisive, at least two contestants bid up to the valuation of the second-ranked contestant, while any others ultimately drop out. Thus, in the limit, equilibria of the Hirshleifer contest share important properties of equilibria of the corresponding all-pay auction.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管冲突的博弈论分析通常基于乘性噪声的假设，但赫什莱弗（1989）所考虑的加性噪声在特定应用中可能同样合理。本文考察了具有异质性估值的n人差分形式竞赛的均衡集合。对于高和中等噪声水平，均衡为纯策略均衡，且最多有一名参与者活跃。然而，对于低噪声水平，我们发现存在多种均衡，其中部分但未必所有参与者进行随机化。在同质性估值情形下，我们获得了对称均衡的部分唯一性结果。随着竞赛的决胜程度不断提高，至少有两名竞争者出价至排名第二的竞争者的估值，而其他竞争者最终退出。因此，在极限情况下，赫什莱弗竞赛的均衡与相应的全支付拍卖的均衡具有重要性质上的相似性。

articles.title_en: Coalitional stability in matching problems with externalities and random preferences
articles.title_cn: 具有外部性和随机偏好的匹配问题中的联盟稳定性
articles.abstract_en: We study coalitional stability in matching problems with externalities, including marriage markets, roommate problems, and Shapley-Scarf housing markets as particular cases. When preferences are randomly determined, the probability of having a coalitionally stable solution is positively affected by three factors: the prudence of coalitions when evaluating a deviation, the social connectedness of those that can react to it, and the incidence of externalities in preferences. At the same time, this probability is negatively affected by the number of agreements that agents can implement to block a matching. In this context, if agents have a limited capacity to organize themselves into large coalitions, then coalitional stability holds asymptotically even when individuals become less and less prudent as the population grows.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了具有外部性的匹配问题中的联盟稳定性，包括婚姻市场、室友问题和Shapley-Scarf住房市场作为特例。当偏好是随机确定时，存在联盟稳定解的概率受到三个因素的正面影响：联盟在评估偏离时的谨慎程度、能够对其作出反应者的社会连通性，以及偏好中外部性的发生率。同时，该概率受到代理人能够实施以阻止匹配的协议数量的负面影响。在此背景下，如果代理人组织成大型联盟的能力有限，那么即使随着人口增长个体变得越来越不谨慎，联盟稳定性也渐近成立。

articles.title_en: Independent versus collective expertise
articles.title_cn: 独立专家意见与集体专家意见
articles.abstract_en: We consider the problem of a decision-maker who seeks for advice from several experts. The experts have reputation concerns which generate incentives to herd on the prior belief about the state of the world. We address the following question: Should the experts be allowed to exchange their information before providing advice (“collective expertise”) or not (“independent expertise”)? We show that collective expertise is more informative than independent expertise under low prior uncertainty about the state and less informative otherwise. We also argue that collective expertise gains advantage as the number of experts grows.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑一个决策者向多位专家寻求建议的问题。专家们具有声誉关切，这产生了在关于世界状态的先验信念上从众的激励。我们探讨以下问题：专家们在提供建议之前是否应被允许交换信息（“集体专家意见”）还是不允许（“独立专家意见”）？我们表明，在对状态的低先验不确定性下，集体专家意见比独立专家意见更具信息量，而在其他情况下则信息量较少。我们还认为，随着专家数量的增加，集体专家意见的优势会增强。

articles.title_en: Cooperation, competition, and welfare in a matching market
articles.title_cn: 匹配市场中的合作、竞争与福利
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the welfare effect of increasing competition in an anonymous two–sided matching market, where matched pairs play an infinitely repeated Prisoner's Dilemma. Higher matching efficiency is usually considered detrimental as it creates stronger incentives for defection. We point out, however, that a reduction in matching frictions also increases welfare because more agents find themselves in a cooperative relationship. We characterize the conditions for which increasing competition increases overall welfare. In particular, this is always the case when the incentives for defection are high.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在匿名双边匹配市场中增加竞争的福利效应，其中匹配的配对进行无限重复的囚徒困境博弈。通常认为更高的匹配效率是有害的，因为它会为背叛创造更强的激励。然而，我们指出，匹配摩擦的减少也会增加福利，因为更多代理人发现自己处于合作关系之中。我们刻画了增加竞争提高整体福利的条件。特别是，当背叛激励较高时，情况总是如此。
